logline: When an arrogant noblewoman catches Juliana in the poisoned Dowager Duchess's chambers, she strikes Juliana with a riding crop and sentences her to scrub the hearth, unaware that Juliana has secretly hidden the antidote and remedy journal to finish the Duchess's cure.
continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 23's cliffhanger inside the West Wing bedchamber, as the brass latch turns and the door swings open to reveal an unexpected intruder confronting Lady Juliana and Prudence.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the ornate brass handle turning slowly on the dark wooden chamber door as it swings open.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Heavy metallic click of the latch and the ominous low creak of the door hinges.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot of the dimly lit, vaulted bedchamber. Lady Juliana and Prudence stand rigid beside the heavy four-poster bed as a haughty blonde noblewoman in an elegant lavender empire-line gown enters, clutching a riding crop.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The noblewoman halts in the center of the chamber, tapping her riding crop against her gloved palm as her cold gaze sweeps across the two maids.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of the noblewoman holding the riding crop upright, regarding Juliana with disdainful authority.

events.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Sharp, Demanding)
events.content: "Who are you?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of Juliana, her gaze lowered deferentially beside the carved wooden bedpost.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Humble, Measured)
events.content: "Juliana, my lady. I was hired for the winter cleaning."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of the noblewoman, her chin tilted up in icy condescension.

events.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Accusatory, Strict)
events.content: "And who gave you permission to enter this chamber?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of the frail Dowager Duchess lying pale and unconscious against the white pillows, gasping weakly for air.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Behind her grey skirt, Juliana quickly slips the small glass remedy vial into her apron pocket with her charcoal-dusted fingers.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up on Juliana's hand swiftly concealing the medicine bottle.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Juliana facing the noblewoman, maintaining a calm, protective facade.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Softly Defiant)
events.content: "I heard her. I thought Her Grace needed help."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Two-shot framing the noblewoman looking down at Juliana, bursting into mocking laughter.

events.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Scoffing, Cruel)
events.content: "You thought? A new maid thinks she knows better than the physicians?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana's resolute expression, her eyes flashing with righteous urgency.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Emphatic, Defiant)
events.content: "She is suffering."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up of the noblewoman's face twisting into a malicious sneer.

events.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Vicious, Venomous)
events.content: "Then let her suffer."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana recoiling slightly in shock at the blatant cruelty.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Steely, Steadfast)
events.content: "I cannot do that."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The noblewoman suddenly rears back her riding crop and strikes Juliana violently across the torso.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: A sharp, stinging whip crack as the riding crop makes harsh contact.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana gasps in pain, clutching her stomach and bending over as she absorbs the brutal strike.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Juliana hunched over in pain, clutching her abdomen.

events.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Cold, Threatening)
events.content: "You are a maid."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low-angle shot looking past the bedpost toward the Duchess, whose trembling hand reaches out limply.

events.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Cold, Continuing)
events.content: "Not a physician. Not a lady."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Dramatic low-angle wide shot of the noblewoman standing imperiously over the doubled-over Juliana.

events.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Disdainful, Final)
events.content: "And certainly not a woman whose opinion matters."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana looking down, enduring the humiliation while stifling her breath.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Subdued, Controlled)
events.content: "Yes, my lady."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of the noblewoman turning the crop in her white-gloved hands with smug satisfaction.

events.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Smug, Condescending)
events.content: "Good. Perhaps we can teach you your place."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The noblewoman leads Juliana and a frightened Prudence down a dark flagstone hallway.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Low tracking shot down the corridor as the hem of the lilac dress sweeps past, followed by Juliana's swift steps.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana's boots step down into a dark, rustic chamber dominated by an enormous, blackened stone hearth.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Wide shot of the vast soot-stained stone fireplace. The noblewoman turns back toward Juliana, crop held at her side.

events.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Harsh, Dismissive)
events.content: "Clean it."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of the noblewoman extending her gloved hand toward the cavernous, filth-laden hearth.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana looking up at the towering, soot-blackened chimney.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (Quiet, Questioning)
events.content: "All of it, my lady?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Extreme close-up two-shot as the noblewoman steps unnervingly close to Juliana's face, whispering with sadistic relish.

events.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Intimate, Venomous)
events.content: "Every stone. Perhaps when your hands are black enough, you will finally remember what you are."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana slowly drops to her knees on the cold flagstones before the soot-filled fireplace.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of Juliana sinking to her knees, her face grim and composed.

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Prudence steps toward the noblewoman in distress, her hands clasped tightly.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Prudence's anxious, trembling face.

events.label: PRUDENCE (Desperate, Pleading)
events.content: "My lady—"

events.label: ACTION
events.content: The noblewoman whips around sharply, thrusting the tip of her riding crop directly into Prudence's face.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium close-up of the noblewoman baring her teeth in rage, aiming the crop threateningly.

events.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Furious, Threatening)
events.content: "Do you want the same punishment?"

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Prudence flinching in terror, lowering her eyes immediately.

events.label: PRUDENCE (Terrified, Murmuring)
events.content: "No, my lady."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana grips a coarse scrubbing brush with both hands and begins vigorously scraping the thick black ash across the hearthstones.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up shot of Juliana's soot-covered hands fiercely scrubbing the black ash along the stone floor.

events.label: SOUND FX
events.content: Rhythmic, harsh rasping sound of bristles scraping against stone.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium shot of the noblewoman leaning casually against the wooden doorframe, watching Juliana toil with smug condescension.

events.label: NOBLEWOMAN (Smug, Gleeful)
events.content: "That is where clever little servants belong."

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Medium profile shot of Juliana kneeling by the hearth in the dim window light, scrubbing steadily.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (V.O.) (Cold, Resolute)
events.content: "Let her think I am only a maid."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana pauses scrubbing. Her soot-caked fingers reach into the deep pocket of her apron, carefully feeling the worn leather cover of her mother's remedy journal and the glass dropper bottle securely concealed within.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Close-up of Juliana's soot-stained hand touching the hidden remedy book and the antidote vial inside her apron pocket.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (V.O.) (Determined, Defiant)
events.content: "Let her believe I am ignorant."

events.label: ACTION
events.content: Juliana raises her head. Smudges of dark soot stain her fair cheek, but her piercing blue eyes burn with unwavering defiance and unyielding resolve as she stares toward the hallway.

events.label: CAMERA
events.content: Tight close-up of Juliana's soot-streaked face turning slowly toward the chamber exit, her jaw set firm as dramatic music builds to a powerful crescendo.

events.label: LADY JULIANA (V.O.) (Steely, Unstoppable)
events.content: "I will return. You cannot stop the healer."
